name: – Riho Terras – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Kosovo
part_text:
The European Parliament gives its opinion on Kosovo's progress towards joining the European Union. It praises Kosovo's commitment but says 2025 was a "lost year" because elections left the country without a working parliament and government for months. It calls on Kosovo to do more against corruption and organised crime, protect media freedom and minority rights, and normalise relations with Serbia. It also asks the five EU countries that have not recognised Kosovo to do so.

- Kosovo must strengthen rule of law, media freedom and minority rights; its people and institutions are affected.
- The five EU members that do not recognise Kosovo are urged to recognise it.
- Kosovo and Serbia are pressed to implement their 2023 agreements; talks continue.
